title: Boolean coefficients under real embedding
statement: For any $n\ge 0$, let $f$ be a function from the binary cube $(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$ to $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. The numerical coefficient of the real-valued indicator of $f$ at $S$ equals the integer alternating sum over all $T\subseteq S$, viewed as a real number: $\displaystyle \sum_{T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}\,\mathbf{1}_{\{f(\mathbf{1}_T)=1\}}$, where $\mathbf{1}_T$ is the binary cube point that is $1$ exactly on $T$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the coordinate set
